feature: Key renewal after accepted transport egress, including raw packet callers
checks: Would-block and failed callbacks do not trigger renewal
Accepted aged raw transport queues a paced renewal
Handshake output does not recursively request renewal
Replacement handshake completes and raw traffic survives original key expiry
Receive-only test bypasses egress scheduling to isolate its receive trigger
limitations: Relay acceptance can mean bounded queue admission rather than physical transmission
Complete keepalive timers and total attempt limits remain unfinished
Physical and independent-peer qualification of these new triggers remains outstanding
